title: Eigenvectors of a symmetric matrix are perpendicular
caption: A = [[2, 1], [1, 2]] has eigenvalue 3 along (1, 1) and eigenvalue 1 along (1, −1). The two eigen-directions meet at a right angle, which is why A = QΛQᵀ with Q orthogonal.
alt: The vector (1, 1) stretched to (3, 3) and the vector (1, −1) unchanged, meeting at a right angle at the origin.
description: A(1, 1) = (3, 3): the direction (1, 1) is stretched by λ = 3.
A(1, −1) = (1, −1): the direction (1, −1) is unchanged, λ = 1.
The two directions are perpendicular, so normalising them gives the orthogonal matrix Q.
